name: Alien Snap
source:
You fled to an unexplored planet - and gotten yourself into millions of debt with Homeplanet. To pay back what you owe, you'll need to build an online following by snapping alien wildlife. But survival means more than making payments. It means learning to trust the crew you're stuck with, and maybe figuring out who you are when nobody back home is watching.

---
It's an Anti-Capitalism, Queer, Sci-Fi story made by one person.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3875790/Alien_Snap/
translation:
你逃到了一个未开发的星球 - 并让自己背负了数以百万计的家园债务。为了偿还你所欠的钱，你需要通过捕捉外星野生动物来建立在线追随者。但生存不仅仅意味着付款。这意味着要学会信任与你同在的船员，也许还要在家里无人注视的情况下弄清楚你是谁。

---
这是一部由一个人创作的反资本主义、酷儿科幻故事。
